title: Fast primal-dual methods for convex-concave bilinear saddle point problems: continuous-time dynamics and discrete algorithms
summary: This paper studies Nesterov accelerated methods for continuously differentiable convex-concave bilinear saddle point problems. For the continuous-time model, we analyze a second-order primal-dual dynamical system with vanishing damping $α/t$, where $α\geq 3$. Under the merely convex-concave setting, we prove convergence of the primal-dual trajectory to a saddle point.
